title: HATTER-SOL-19: Boolean Geometry of Mathematical Presentations - Observability, Hiding, and Re-exposure Across Compilation and FPGA Realization
description: A controlled study of three E0-equivalent mathematical presentations tracked through generic synthesis and two FPGA vendor toolchains. The main empirical result is a replicated joint measured physical partition {{DIRECT12,PREFIX19},{NIELSEN12}} on Cyclone V / Quartus II 13.1 and Gowin GW5A-25A / Gowin Education IDE 1.9.9Beta-4, despite DIRECT12/PREFIX19 re-separation at an earlier generic ABC-fast observer. The claim is finite, observer-relative, and does not assert routed-netlist identity, universal technology invariance, or unrestricted circuit lower bounds.
notes: HATTER-SOL-19 preprint package. Two physical laboratories each preserve a SHA-256 provenance manifest over 33 key local run artifacts. DOI to be inserted after Zenodo publication.
